_source: UHV-A1 (docs/eras/uhv.md, 'A1. Transcurium' and 'Older machines, new modes'): the spent HFIR driver row of UV's pyroprocessing cell. Real process: the electrorefining of spent metallic and dispersion fuel in molten LiCl (EBR-II at Argonne), the same route as the cell's thorium rows.
_how_it_is_used: Read by server_scripts/grindless/uv/thorium.js: types.pyroprocessing.recipes are merged into thorium.json's pyroprocessing recipes before the checks (name, circuit one per recipe, contents), so this row is built and published exactly like those. Circuit 5: 1-4 are UV's.
Format: thorium.json's (itemsIn, kept, charge, fluidsIn, itemsOut, fluidsOut; eut x duration).

Balance: 2 driver elements take 3 uranium-233 (tables/transcurium_fabrication.json); 2 spent ones give 2 back, so a cycle of six burns three (the burn-up). Destinations: the radioactive waste (fission products and the aluminium cladding) -> ZPM's waste retrieval plant; the loaded salt -> cleaned by the cell's circuit 4.
